slides.title: Stop planning a giant New Year home overhaul. Do this instead.
Pick one room, not the house
slides.body: The room you use most. One finished room beats five started ones.

slides.title: Pick one habit, not a system
slides.body: Like 'shoes go on the rack.' One small habit you can repeat without thinking.

slides.title: Start in late December
slides.body: No big January 1 launch. Start small the week before, so the new year doesn't feel like a test.

slides.title: Plan your restart day now
slides.body: Decide what you'll do the first time you miss a day. Missing is part of the plan.

slides.title: A reset you can repeat beats a resolution you can't.
Tiny resets that count
items: One load of laundry, start to drawer

slides.title: Want the reset done for you?
slides.body: The Messy Brain Home Reset is a 7-day shame-free home reset. Start it before New Year. Link in bio.

caption:
Every January I used to try to fix the whole house in a weekend.
What's the one room you'd reset first?
